mapper.insert: INSERT INTO fee_rules ( platform, market, asset, side, role, fee_type, fee_value, fee_currency, min_fee, max_fee, effective_from, effective_to, is_active, notes, created_at ) VALUES ( #{platform}, #{market}, #{asset}, #{side}, #{role}, #{feeType}, #{feeValue}, #{feeCurrency}, #{minFee}, #{maxFee}, #{effectiveFrom}, #{effectiveTo}, #{isActive}, #{notes}, #{createdAt} )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM fee_rules ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM fee_rules WHERE platform = #{platform} AND market = #{market} AND asset = #{asset} AND is_active = TRUE AND effective_from <= #{atDate} AND (effective_to IS NULL OR effective_to > #{atDate}) AND (side IS NULL OR side = #{side}) AND (role IS NULL OR role = #{role}) ORDER BY -- Priorité : règle la plus spécifique (side+role non null) en premier (CASE WHEN side IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, (CASE WHEN role IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) DESC, effective_from DESC LIMIT 1
